title: Talking-head highlights
summary: Find the strongest point in a long recording and cut it into a subtitled short.
description: Cut a long talking-head, interview or livestream recording into a focused short: a strong opening, a complete point and easy-to-read subtitles. Remove pauses and repetition while keeping what the speaker meant.
brief: Here's {{recording}}. Cut a highlight clip focused on {{topic to keep}}, for posting on {{platform}}.

fields.label: recording
fields.hint: The attached recording: roughly how long it is and what it covers

fields.label: topic to keep
fields.hint: The point or topic to cut out; to let the agent choose, write "you pick"
fields.example: the guest's views on remote work

fields.label: platform
fields.hint: Where it will be posted; this sets the pace and length
